=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_claude_fixer_judge.py:183-216, 251-254 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Duplicate upheld rulings for one finding can be deduplicated before the unclassified check, allowing a finding with an invalid or missing category to bypass the cap hold and merge with a follow-up.
  WHY: Equal-ranked rulings retain whichever appears first, so an uncategorized duplicate may not reach the unclassified tracker; severity disagreement: reviewers rated this BLOCKER or MAJOR, and the highest rating is used.
- scripts/review_claude_fixer_judge.py:270–276 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Sticky matching can treat distinct findings with the same normalized claim as the same finding when they are in the same file and within three lines.
  WHY: A later, distinct defect may be moved out of the counted findings, causing the review round to be treated as clean.
- README.md: lines 90-91 (variable table rows for `CLAUDE_FIXER_JUDGE_ENABLED` and `CLAUDE_FIXER_JUDGE_FIX_CAP`) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The operator-facing variable table omits the same-claim condition for sticky matching and the new hold for upheld findings with no ruling or no valid category.
  WHY: Operators reading the table get an incomplete description of judge behavior that contradicts the implementation and the updated narrative documentation.
- changelog.d/4648-claude-fixer-gpt-judge.md:4, 9 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The existing changelog fragment is edited alongside a new fragment for the same PR, and its body prose and table row disagree about the sticky-matching rule.
  WHY: The edit violates the one-fragment-per-PR requirement; the body still describes matching without the same-claim condition while the table includes it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_claude_fixer_judge.py: 194-205 (by_id dedup), 207-215 (unclassified tracker), 251 (cap hold check) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The unclassified tracker runs on deduplicated `by_id`, so an equal-ranked duplicate ruling with an empty category may be discarded before it reaches the tracker and the cap hold check.
  WHY: At the cap, the uncategorized upheld finding can therefore be absent from `unclassified`, causing the run to merge with a follow-up.
- changelog.d/4648-claude-fixer-gpt-judge.md: line 4 (body prose), line 9 (table row) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: This PR edits the existing fragment while adding a new fragment, and the existing fragment's body prose and table row contradict each other about the same-claim condition.
  WHY: The new fragment already documents both fixes; the existing body still describes the rule without the same-claim condition.

  Evidence of absence: README.md line 90 still reads Findings on later rounds that match an invalid ruling (same file, within 3 lines) are listed as non-blocking. without same claim. The narrative paragraph at line 1473 was updated correctly but the variable table was not.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The GPT judge documentation should cover the new hold reason for upheld findings with no ruling or no valid category, matching what agents.md and the hand-off script header now describe.
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md line 62 (and its workflow-templates twin)
  Evidence of absence: implement-plan-claude.md line 62 says at the judge-fix cap (CLAUDE_FIXER_JUDGE_FIX_CAP, default 2 per PR, never reset) -> merge with a follow-up issue, or ai:needs-human when an upheld finding is security or data-loss but does not mention the new upheld_unruled_or_uncategorized_at_cap hold reason that was added for findings with no ruling or no valid category.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  Requirement: CLAUDE.md S20.B: One fragment per PR. Never reuse another PR's filename.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/4648-claude-fixer-gpt-judge.md (revert the edit to the table row)
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff modifies changelog.d/4648-claude-fixer-gpt-judge.md line 9 (table row) while also creating a new changelog.d/6050-claude-fixer-judge-security-follow-ups.md. The new fragment already documents both security follow-ups and the same-claim refinement, making the edit to the 4648 fragment redundant and a one-fragment-per-PR violation. === FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_claude_fixer_judge.py: lines 183-216 (especially `_ruling_caution` and the `by_id` dedup loop) and lines 251-252 (cap-level hold check) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Equal-ranked duplicate upheld rulings can cause the dedup loop to drop an empty-category ruling before the unclassified check.
  WHY: If the model emits a category and then an empty category, the uncategorized duplicate may be discarded and the cap path may merge with a follow-up instead of holding.
- changelog.d/4648-claude-fixer-gpt-judge.md: lines 4 (body) vs 9 (table row) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The body paragraph and table row in the edited fragment disagree about whether sticky rulings require the same claim.
  WHY: The assembled changelog entry would describe inconsistent sticky-ruling behavior.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "agents.md and README.md describe the narrower sticky rule and the new hold." (PR DESCRIPTION, "Docs" section, plus §28.B's fail-closed-as-documented expectation)
  Expected change site: README.md lines 90-91 (variable-table rows for `CLAUDE_FIXER_JUDGE_ENABLED` and `CLAUDE_FIXER_JUDGE_FIX_CAP`)
  Evidence of absence: README.md line 90 still ends with "Findings on later rounds that match an `invalid` ruling (same file, within 3 lines) are listed as non-blocking." and line 91 still ends with "merges with a follow-up issue for the upheld findings, or holds with `ai:needs-human` when one of them is security or data-loss." Neither row mentions the same-claim condition or the new `upheld_unruled_or_uncategorized_at_cap` hold reason, even though agents.md (lines 107-109 and 127-128) and the changelog fragment both describe them. The narrative paragraph at line 1474 was updated; the operator-facing variable table that operators consult first was not.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: CLAUDE.md §20.B ("One fragment per PR. Never reuse another PR's filename — the unique path is the whole point.") and the parallel agents.md line 2237 ("Write one fragment per PR at… One fragment per PR").
  Expected change site: changelog.d/4648-claude-fixer-gpt-judge.md (must remain untouched by this PR)
  Evidence of absence: This PR adds a new fragment `changelog.d/6050-claude-fixer-judge-security-follow-ups.md` AND modifies the existing `changelog.d/4648-claude-fixer-gpt-judge.md` (line 9 row edit), so the PR touches two fragment paths. The new fragment already documents both #6050 and #6051, so the edit to the 4648 fragment is duplicative. The 4648 fragment was merged into CHANGELOG.md when PR #4648 landed, so editing it now rewrites shipped release text and breaks the one-fragment-per-PR invariant the `lint-pr-body-auto-close` workflow's sibling check is meant to enforce.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "agents.md and README.md describe the narrower sticky rule and the new hold." (PR DESCRIPTION, "Docs" section)
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md line 62 (and twin at workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md line 62)
  Evidence of absence: The command file at line 62 still reads "at the judge-fix cap (`CLAUDE_FIXER_JUDGE_FIX_CAP`, default 2 per PR, never reset) → merge with a follow-up issue, or `ai:needs-human` when an upheld finding is security or data-loss", with no mention of the new `upheld_unruled_or_uncategorized_at_cap` hold reason. When a session reads this command and a judge run produces the new hold, the session will not know the hold is expected behaviour and may stop as a blocked PR or interpret it as a defect.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
